boiler_efficiency.uncertainty: Site-specific; replace with measured boiler efficiency (direct or indirect method) when available. Typical industrial range 70–90 % depending on age, fuel and load.
boiler_efficiency.notes: Planning default only. Derived from common industrial steam-boiler performance cited in MNRE/GIZ and Energy Innovation 2026 context. Do not present as a measured plant value.

steam_distribution_efficiency.uncertainty: Highly site-specific (insulation quality, condensate return, length of network). Replace with measured distribution losses when available.
steam_distribution_efficiency.notes: Planning default only. Do not present as a measured plant value.

process_heat_utilization.uncertainty: Process-specific. Validate against actual process heat demand and any unaccounted losses (radiant, flash, etc.).
process_heat_utilization.notes: Planning default only. Validate for the specific process.
